svg.title: ExoStack — wearable robotics illustration — for dark backgrounds
svg.desc: Illustrative wearable robotics artwork without a wordmark or tagline. An artistic loop connects enlarged sensing, motion planning and rotary actuation symbols. The trailing-thigh link and cuff remain absent. SENSE, PLAN and ACTUATE are complete, editable Arial text. Transparent dark-background colour treatment; geometry and editable Arial lettering are preserved.
